lessons.title: Mening kunim: I get up at seven
lessons.goal: Kun tartibingizni gapirib berishni o'rganasiz: 25 ta kundalik fe'l va Present Simple + vaqt.

frame.name: Present Simple + kun tartibi
frame.formula:
I get up at seven.
She gets up at six.
Then I wash my face and put on my clothes.
I don't work on Sunday.
frame.explain: Kun tartibi — Present Simple uchun eng yaxshi mavzu, chunki har kuni bir xil ish takrorlanadi. Fe'llar odatda phrasal bo'ladi: get up (turmoq), put on (kiyib olmoq), take off (yechmoq). Ularni bo'laklarga ajratmasdan, birikma sifatida yodlang.

aff: She wears a uniform at work.
neg: I don't get up at seven.
She doesn't wear a uniform at work.
q: Do you get up at seven?
Does she wear a uniform at work?
short: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.

examples.en: I get up at seven, wash my face and put on my clothes.
examples.uz: Yettida turaman, yuzimni yuvaman va kiyinaman.

examples.en: She wakes up early, drinks a cup of coffee and starts work at nine.
examples.uz: U erta uyg'onadi, bir piyola qahva ichadi va to'qqizda ishni boshlaydi.

examples.en: He doesn't shave every day, and he doesn't wear a tie at work.
examples.uz: U har kuni soqol olmaydi va ishda galstuk taqmaydi.

examples.en: We eat together in the evening and then walk in the park.
examples.uz: Kechqurun birga ovqatlanamiz, keyin bog'da yuramiz.

examples.en: My mother cooks and bakes on Sundays, and we keep the food in the fridge.
examples.uz: Onam yakshanba kunlari ovqat pishiradi va non yopadi, ovqatni muzlatgichda saqlaymiz.

examples.en: Take off your shoes, sit down and open your book, please.
examples.uz: Iltimos, oyoq kiyimingizni yeching, o'tiring va kitobingizni oching.

examples.en: They study at the university and work in a shop at the weekend.
examples.uz: Ular universitetda o'qiydi va dam olish kunlari do'konda ishlaydi.

examples.en: He runs in the morning, and his sister plays tennis after work.
examples.uz: U ertalab yuguradi, singlisi esa ishdan keyin tennis o'ynaydi.

street.title: Kundalik hayot
street.note: "I'm off to work" — "ishga ketyapman" (norasmiy); "Let's call it a day" — ishni tugatishni taklif qilish.

lines.en: What time do you get up?
At six. I run for twenty minutes, then I wash and have breakfast.
lines.uz: Oltida. Yigirma daqiqa yuguraman, keyin yuvinaman va nonushta qilaman.

lines.en: Do you cook breakfast yourself?
Yes, I cook eggs and make tea. My wife bakes bread on Sundays.
lines.uz: Ha, tuxum pishiraman va choy qilaman. Xotinim yakshanba kuni non yopadi.

lines.en: And what time do you start work?
At nine. I open the office and check my email.
lines.uz: To'qqizda. Ofisni ochaman va pochtamni tekshiraman.

substitution.answer: I wash my face every morning.
He wears a suit at work.

translate.en: Take off your coat and sit down.
They don't work at the weekend.

lessons.tip: wake up — uyg'onmoq (ko'z ochish), get up — turmoq (karavotdan chiqish). put on — kiyib olmoq (harakat), wear — kiyib yurmoq (holat): I put on my coat / I wear a coat in winter.

lessons.title: Xohish va iltimos: I want to ...
lessons.goal: Xohish, umid, qaror va minnatdorchilikni bildirishni o'rganasiz: want to, would like to, enjoy + V-ing.

frame.name: want to / would like to / enjoy + V-ing
frame.formula:
I want to ask you a question.
She wants to buy a new phone.
I'd like to thank you.
I like reading books.
frame.explain: want, need, decide, try, hope fe'llaridan keyin to + fe'l keladi. enjoy, like, hate dan keyin esa fe'l + ing. Xushmuomala xohish uchun would like to ishlatiladi: I'd like to ask.

aff: I want to ask a question.
neg: I don't want to ask a question.
She doesn't want to learn English.
q: Do you want to ask a question?
Does she want to learn English?
short: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.

examples.en: I want to ask you a question about the project.
examples.uz: Sizga loyiha haqida bir savol bermoqchiman.

examples.en: She wants to learn English because she hopes to work abroad.
examples.uz: U ingliz tilini o'rganmoqchi, chunki chet elda ishlashga umid qiladi.

examples.en: I'd like to thank you for your help.
examples.uz: Yordamingiz uchun sizga minnatdorchilik bildirmoqchiman.

examples.en: Excuse me, I don't remember your name — can you remind me?
examples.uz: Kechirasiz, ismingizni eslay olmayapman — eslatib yubora olasizmi?

examples.en: My sister dreams of a big house, and she hopes to buy one next year.
examples.uz: Singlim katta uyni orzu qiladi va kelasi yil sotib olishga umid qiladi.

examples.en: We enjoy watching films together, and my brother likes cooking.
examples.uz: Biz birga film ko'rishdan zavqlanamiz, akam esa ovqat pishirishni yoqtiradi.

examples.en: He persuaded me to stay, and I agreed with him.
examples.uz: U meni qolishga ishontirdi va men u bilan rozi bo'ldim.

examples.en: Let me introduce my colleague and explain our idea.
examples.uz: Hamkasbimni tanishtiray va g'oyamizni tushuntiraymi.

street.title: Istak va iltimos

items.en: I'd like to ask you something.

street.note: "Can I have a word?" — "ikki og'iz gap gaplashsak bo'ladimi?"; norasmiy suhbatda juda ko'p ishlatiladi.

lines.en: Excuse me, can I ask you a question?
Sure, go ahead.
I want to introduce myself. My name is Aziz, I'm the new designer.
lines.uz: O'zimni tanishtirmoqchiman. Men Aziz, yangi dizaynerman.

lines.en: Nice to meet you! Do you want to explain your idea at the meeting?
Yes, I'd like to show some examples.
Great. I hope the team agrees with us.
lines.uz: Zo'r. Jamoa biz bilan rozi bo'ladi deb umid qilaman.

substitution.answer: I want to ask a question.

translate.en: I want to ask you a question.

fix.wrong: I want that you help me.
fix.right: I want you to help me.

lessons.tip: want / need / decide / hope / try + to + fe'l, enjoy / like / hate + fe'l-ing. "I want that you help me" — o'zbekchadan so'zma-so'z tarjima, xato. To'g'risi: I want you to help me.

lessons.title: Kecha nima qildingiz? Past Simple (-ed)
lessons.goal: O'tgan zamonda gapirishni boshlaysiz: to'g'ri fe'llar (-ed) va did / didn't.

frame.name: Past Simple: to'g'ri fe'llar
frame.formula:
I worked yesterday.
She visited her parents.
We didn't stay at home.
Did you call him?
frame.explain: O'tgan zamonda to'g'ri fe'llarga -ed qo'shiladi. Muhim qoida: did paydo bo'lsa (savol yoki inkorda), fe'l o'zak shaklga qaytadi: Did you work?, I didn't work.

neg: I didn't call my friend yesterday.
short: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
Yes, she did. / No, she didn't.

examples.en: Yesterday I called my friend, and we met in a cafe near the office.
examples.uz: Kecha do'stimga qo'ng'iroq qildim va ofis yaqinidagi kafeda uchrashdik.

examples.en: She visited her parents at the weekend and helped them in the garden.
examples.uz: U dam olish kunlari ota-onasinikiga bordi va bog'da yordam berdi.

examples.en: We ordered pizza, paid by card and watched a film at home.
examples.uz: Biz pitsa buyurtma qildik, karta bilan to'ladik va uyda film ko'rdik.

examples.en: I didn't buy anything because the shop was closed.
examples.uz: Hech narsa sotib olmadim, chunki do'kon yopiq edi.

examples.en: He travelled to Samarkand last month and showed me a lot of photos.
examples.uz: U o'tgan oy Samarqandga sayohat qildi va menga ko'p surat ko'rsatdi.

examples.en: Did you receive my letter, or did you only check the email?
examples.uz: Xatimni oldingizmi yoki faqat elektron pochtani tekshirdingizmi?

examples.en: The company provided a car and offered a good salary.
examples.uz: Kompaniya mashina berdi va yaxshi maosh taklif qildi.

examples.en: They argued about the plan and didn't solve the problem.
examples.uz: Ular reja haqida bahslashdilar va muammoni hal qilmadilar.

street.title: Kecha nima qildingiz?
street.note: "Nothing special" — "hech qanday alohida narsa emas", savolga eng tabiiy qisqa javoblardan biri.

lines.en: What did you do at the weekend?
I visited my parents and helped my father in the garage.
lines.uz: Ota-onamnikiga bordim va dadamga garajda yordam berdim.

lines.en: Did you travel anywhere?
No, I didn't. I stayed at home and watched films.
lines.uz: Yo'q. Uyda qoldim va film ko'rdim.

lines.en: Did you call your brother?
Yes, we talked for an hour and joked a lot.
lines.uz: Ha, bir soat gaplashdik va ko'p hazillashdik.

substitution.answer: He washed his car last week.

fix.why: tasdiq gapda did va -ed birga kelmaydi

lessons.tip: did ishlatilganda fe'l o'zak shaklda qoladi: Did you work? / I didn't work. Faqat tasdiq gapda -ed qo'shiladi: I worked.

lessons.title: Noto'g'ri fe'llar: I went, I saw, I bought
lessons.goal: Eng kerakli noto'g'ri fe'llarning 2-shaklini o'zlashtirasiz va harakat fe'llari lug'atini kengaytirasiz.

frame.name: Past Simple: noto'g'ri fe'llar
frame.formula:
go → went        I went home.
buy → bought     She bought a car.
see → saw        We saw a film.
inkor: He didn't go home.
frame.explain: Noto'g'ri fe'llar -ed olmaydi — ularning o'z 2-shakli bor. Ularni jadval bo'lib yodlash eng samarali usul. Inkor va savolda esa hammasi bir xil: didn't + o'zak, Did ... + o'zak.

neg: They didn't build a new house.
q: Did they build a new house?
short: Yes, he did. / No, he didn't.
Yes, they did. / No, they didn't.

examples.en: I found my keys under the table and picked them up.
examples.uz: Kalitlarimni stol ostidan topdim va oldim.

examples.en: She won the competition last year and moved to another city.
examples.uz: U o'tgan yili musobaqada yutdi va boshqa shaharga ko'chdi.

examples.en: The child fell from the bicycle, but he didn't break his arm.
examples.uz: Bola velosipeddan yiqildi, lekin qo'lini sindirmadi.

examples.en: We flew to Istanbul, swam in the sea and sang songs in the evening.
examples.uz: Biz Istanbulga uchdik, dengizda suzdik va kechqurun qo'shiq aytdik.

examples.en: He grew vegetables in the garden and sold them at the market.
examples.uz: U bog'da sabzavot o'stirdi va ularni bozorda sotdi.

examples.en: She drew a picture of the mountains and hung it on the wall.
examples.uz: U tog'lar tasvirini chizdi va devorga osdi.

examples.en: They argued about money, but then they found a solution.
examples.uz: Ular pul haqida janjallashdi, keyin yechim topdilar.

examples.en: The wind blew all night and broke a big tree in the yard.
examples.uz: Butun tun shamol esdi va hovlidagi katta daraxtni sindirdi.

street.title: Nima bo'ldi?
street.note: lose → lost, have a good time → had a great time — bu birikmalar kundalik nutqda eng ko'p uchraydigan noto'g'ri fe'llardan.

lines.en: What happened at the competition?
My brother won the first prize!
That's great! Did he train a lot?
Yes, he ran every morning and swam twice a week.
lines.uz: Ha, har kuni ertalab yugurdi va haftada ikki marta suzdi.

lines.en: Did you go with him?
Yes, we flew together, and I took a lot of photos.
lines.uz: Ha, birga uchdik va men ko'p surat oldim.

substitution.prompt: I ___ my keys under the table. (find)
substitution.answer: I found my keys under the table.

substitution.prompt: They ___ a new house last year. (build)
substitution.answer: They built a new house last year.

lessons.tip: Noto'g'ri fe'llarni uch shaklda yodlang: go – went – gone, see – saw – seen, break – broke – broken. Ikkinchi shakl o'tgan zamon uchun, uchinchisi esa have bilan (31-dars) ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Savol va inkor o'tgan zamonda: Did you ...?
lessons.goal: O'tgan zamonda savol berish va inkor qilishni mustahkamlaysiz: did, didn't, so'roq so'zlari.

frame.name: Did / didn't + o'zak fe'l
frame.formula:
Did you see him?      — Yes, I did.
Where did you go?
I didn't see him.
She didn't tell me.
frame.explain: O'tgan zamondagi savol va inkor faqat did orqali yasaladi. did dan keyin fe'l hech qachon 2-shaklda kelmaydi: Did you saw? — xato, Did you see? — to'g'ri. So'roq so'zi bo'lsa, u eng oldinda turadi.
table: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
Did you see? ✓ / Did you saw? ✗

short: Yes, he did. / No, he didn't.
Yes, they did. / No, they didn't.

examples.en: Did you celebrate your birthday at home or in a restaurant?
examples.uz: Tug'ilgan kuningizni uyda nishonladingizmi yoki restoranda?

examples.en: Where did you buy this table? It cost a lot, I think.
examples.uz: Bu stolni qayerdan oldingiz? Qimmatga tushgan bo'lsa kerak.

examples.en: He didn't let me pay, and he didn't want to disturb anyone.
examples.uz: U menga to'lashga ruxsat bermadi va hech kimni bezovta qilishni xohlamadi.

examples.en: The ship sank near the island, but nobody died.
examples.uz: Kema orol yaqinida cho'kdi, lekin hech kim halok bo'lmadi.

examples.en: I didn't intend to argue — I only wanted to support your idea.
examples.uz: Men bahslashmoqchi emasdim — faqat g'oyangizni qo'llab-quvvatlamoqchi edim.

examples.en: Did the medicine help? — My throat stopped hurting after I boiled some water with honey.
examples.uz: Dori yordam berdimi? — Asalli suv qaynatganimdan keyin tomog'im og'rimay qo'ydi.

examples.en: She fed the cat, saved some money and returned home late.
examples.uz: U mushukni boqdi, bir oz pul tejadi va kech uyga qaytdi.

examples.en: His words influenced me, and I avoided that mistake.
examples.uz: Uning so'zlari menga ta'sir qildi va men o'sha xatodan qochdim.

street.title: Savol-javob

items.en: Yes, I did. Sorry, I forgot to answer.

street.note: "I didn't mean to" — bilmasdan xato qilganda aytiladigan eng tabiiy uzr.

lines.en: Did you celebrate New Year with your family?
Yes, we did. We cooked a lot and my mother baked a cake.
lines.uz: Ha. Ko'p ovqat tayyorladik, onam tort yopdi.

lines.en: Did anyone come late?
My uncle came after ten, but he didn't disturb us.
lines.uz: Tog'am o'ndan keyin keldi, lekin bizni bezovta qilmadi.

lines.en: And what did you do after dinner?
We sang songs and my father told funny stories.
lines.uz: Qo'shiq aytdik, dadam kulgili voqealarni aytib berdi.

lessons.tip: did — o'tgan zamonning yordamchisi. U paydo bo'lsa, fe'l o'zak shaklga qaytadi: Did you go? / I didn't go. Faqat tasdiq gapda fe'l 2-shaklda turadi: I went.
